objects.name: Dying rebel
objects.description: Human in blue trousers lying on the street walkway (about 1.5 x 0.7 tiles), drawn as a sprite (not in the map tiles). Talk with ENTER plays a cutscene; afterwards he stays lying there as a corpse.

refs.caption: rebel lying on street, right of rubble
same body seen from the lift area

objects.name: Crowbar pickup
objects.description: Item spot in front of the chain-link fence on the floor-38 ledge (map cell 25,43). No ground sprite is visible in footage before pickup; the pickup plays a short clip and prints NAŠEL JSI PÁČIDLO.

refs.caption: fence at crowbar spot, message after pickup

objects.name: Electrical distribution box (wire source)
objects.description: Small square dark-green wall panel with a light frame (about 1 x 1 tile) on the concrete wall under the colonnade building marked 05. After the wire is ripped out the panel shows a lightning icon. The same green lightning panel tile reappears beside card door 17.

refs.caption: panel after wire taken, lightning icon

objects.name: Second switchboard (metro)
objects.description: Dark-green wall panel (about 1 x 1 tile, same style as the wire box) on the dark pillar between two metro carriages; the player stands in front of it, so it is partly hidden in every frame. Wiring it powers the metro (tunnel lights) and unlocks the train door.

refs.caption: green panel on pillar behind player

objects.name: Metro train door
objects.description: Door at the left end of the bloodied subway carriage (map cells 60-61, rows 67-69, about 2 x 3 tiles). Locked until the switchboard is wired; the crowbar pries it open (METROPAC clip), leaving a dark doorway into the train.

objects.name: Pipe valve wheel (tap handle source)
objects.description: Small round handwheel with a cross (about 0.5 tile) on the vertical leg of a large L-shaped grey tunnel pipe near the E-blaster spot (map col ~43, row 73). Messages KOHOUTEK JSI URVAL / ODŠROUBOVAL JSI KOHOUT suggest the wheel is unscrewed and carried; which pipe is marker 6 is unclear (see waterPipe).

objects.name: Leaking water pipe / shut-off
objects.description: Rusty vertical pipe coming out of the tunnel ceiling at map cell 20, rows 72-74, pouring a pale yellow-green stream to the floor; a broken ceiling pipe with a rust hole sits beside it. Closing the valve (KOHOUTEM JSI UZAVŘEL PROUDÍCÍ VODU) swaps the stream tiles for a plain pipe in map M13.

objects.name: Corpse with card and holo-plan
objects.description: Dead human in blue lying beside a boulder rubble pile in the tunnel side room (map cell 16,69), about 2 x 0.5 tiles. Player kneels to search (prompt MRTVÉ TĚLO, kneel clip); body stays after looting.

refs.caption: player kneeling at body by rubble

objects.name: E-Blaster pickup
objects.description: Weapon spot on the metro tunnel floor (map cell 40,74). No ground sprite seen; when near, a yellow 'E-BLASTER' label with an icon appears top right of the playfield, then NAŠEL JSI E-BLASTER.

objects.name: Bar building and NPC door
objects.description: Ruined grey concrete building with a jagged broken roof line, two fluted pillars and a recessed blue-grey door with a small red-white sign above it (door about 1 x 3 tiles, building about 6 x 4). Using it opens the NPC face dialogue; used twice (tradeHoloPlan, tradeShipPart).

objects.name: Crashed ship with hull cover
objects.description: Grey-olive wedge-shaped landing craft with a dark cockpit and landing struts, sitting on a hazard-striped landing pad (map cells 11-19, rows 38-41, about 8 x 3 tiles). Shooting the cover by the nozzles drops the ship part (SOUČÁSTKA) to the ground.

refs.caption: video B: ship on pad, player in front

objects.name: Ship part pickup
objects.description: Part that falls out of the ship hull; picked from the ground (ZE ZEMĚ JSI SEBRAL SOUČÁSTKU Z RAKETY). No ground sprite identified. Look follows the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRSOUC.GRA`: ribbed drum between two end plates on a base plate, orange wires arcing from the drum to one end plate.

objects.name: Plasma fire barrier
objects.description: Column of tall orange-yellow flame tongues, 1 tile wide and 2 tiles tall, standing on the walkway at map cell 103, rows 42-43, between a ruined wall and a grey factory block with ribbed cylinders. Blocks the way to the controller; removed in map M15. Likely animated (flicker) in game, not confirmed.

objects.name: Code lock
objects.description: Keypad lock right next to the plasma; decoder removes the password. Not identified in map or footage - candidates are the reddish-brown wall box left of the flames (cells 99-100, row 41) or the small panel on the factory block (cell 115, row 42). The X*.GRA keypad close-ups may be its UI.

objects.name: Lift controller pickup
objects.description: Item spot at map cell 112,50 on floor 45, by a small green machine and fence, left of a heap of fallen girders. No item sprite in the map; never reached in footage. Look follows the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PROVL.GRA`: grey slab with a red block and a row of white keys.

objects.name: Damaged lift
objects.description: Standard lift shaft by a lattice pylon (map col 56, floors 31-38) whose control panel is broken: OVLÁDACÍ PANEL VÝTAHU JE POŠKOZEN; walkthrough calls it a snowy/grainy screen. Using the controller on it opens floors 24, 17 and 10.
objects.note: The level draws the liftPanel asset for this object (state 1 damaged, 0 repaired), since the map lift draws the lift itself.

refs.caption: video B: damaged-panel message at lift

objects.name: Acid tank
objects.description: Tall corrugated cylindrical silo with a conical grey roof, stencilled ACID, on stubby stone legs (map cells 113-117, rows 18-23, about 4 x 5 tiles) with an outlet pipe toward the floor below. The tap handle fitted to the pipe pours acid on the acid-only guard one floor down; in M16 a handwheel shows on the pipe and the guard tiles are wreckage.

refs.caption: map M11: tank and guard floor
map M16: tap fitted, guard wreck

objects.name: Acid guard
objects.description: Guard robot that normal weapons cannot kill, standing on floor 30 at map cells 109-111, rows 27-29 (drawn as map tiles, not a sprite). It blocks the way to the lift up to the crane level. Acid from the tank one floor up destroys it; map variant M16 swaps it for wreckage. Our look is a compact walker built on the flyer hull with the original stepped red visor (spikes/enemy-design).

objects.name: Crane key pickup
objects.description: Small key lying behind the shoot-only guard on the top floor (engine item 15,10, map ~cell 21, row 15). Not seen in footage or map tiles. Look follows the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRKLIC.GRA`: silver key with a round bow.

refs.caption: map: top floor around guard and key

objects.name: Wires
objects.description: One orange insulated wire with bare silver ends, ripped out of the electrical distribution box (marker 3); carried to the metro switchboard. Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRDRAT.GRA`.

objects.name: Tap handle
objects.description: Chrome handwheel with four spokes and a hub, unscrewed from the tunnel pipe (marker 6); used against the acid guard. Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRKOH.GRA`.

objects.name: Card
objects.description: Grey access card with an orange L band, gold contact pads and a barcode, found on the corpse in the train (marker 7); opens card door 17. Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRKART.GRA`.

objects.name: Holo plan
objects.description: Brown box projector with a white top panel, blue rim and slotted front, found on the corpse in the train (marker 7); traded at marker 9. Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRHOLO.GRA`.

objects.name: Ship plan
objects.description: White sheet with technical drawings of the ship, traded for the holo plan (marker 9). Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRPLAN.GRA`.

objects.name: Decoder
objects.description: Grey handheld device with a red display, ridged keys and green and orange lights, traded for the ship part (marker 9); unlocks the plasma barrier. Inventory item only, no level sprite; drawn after the inventory preview `GRAFIKA/PRDEKOD.GRA`.

objects.name: Crane beam
objects.description: Long green riveted I-beam with orange clamp bands (about 7 x 1 tiles, map cells 23-31, row 13) hung from a single chain by a triangular bridle; a winch block and a small control box sit nearby. Repairing it with the key lets the player cross = level end.

refs.caption: Steam shot: hanging beam on chain

objects.name: Card door 17
objects.description: Narrow grey metal door section with cyan pipes, 1 tile wide and 3 tall, at map cell 49, rows 20-22, between green lightning-icon card panels (same tile as the wire box). Map M14 replaces these cells (door opened). Never seen in footage.

objects.name: Lift platform and shaft
objects.description: Narrow vertical shaft with a toothed rack rail between two guide rails; the car is a small railed platform with a hazard-striped base (about 2 x 1 tiles plus railing). In the map the shaft shows as a dotted rung column. Player cannot hide while riding.

objects.name: Lift call / control box
objects.description: Small dark box with a yellow-orange triangle or arrow sign (about 1 x 0.5 tiles) on a post or wall beside lifts; a taller post version stands at street lifts. Function inferred (the damaged lift message names a lift control panel).

refs.caption: low box and tall post at street lift

objects.name: Steel barrel
objects.description: Ribbed grey steel drum, about 1 x 1.2 tiles, at the street start. Seen as hide cover; engine has an explosive-barrel message (ZNIČIL JSI BAREL S VÝBUŠNINOU) but no barrel was shot in level 1 footage. Whether hiding needs a prop is unknown.

objects.name: Slatted crate / small machine box
objects.description: Low brown box with vertical slats or a window grille (about 1-1.5 x 1 tiles) on streets and lift platforms; sizes vary (merged). Seen as hide cover. Looks like the small mid-ground huts at reduced size, so it may be a background tile rather than a solid prop - unsure.

objects.name: Parallax sky and skyline
objects.description: Full-screen backdrop: rust-red and brown dithered clouds over black ruined-city silhouettes (antenna towers, block houses with lit windows). Scrolls much slower than the playfield. Frame 1 adds white lightning bolts and brighter clouds. The orange glowing strip below row 170 is probably outside the 169 px playfield.

objects.name: Mid-ground ruined huts
objects.description: Small dark brown block houses with window grids and broken posts standing just behind the walkway (1-3 tiles), drawn as map tiles in front of the sky.

objects.name: Street walkway floor
objects.description: Riveted rust-brown and olive metal walkway, 1 tile thick, with a row of rounded plates and small hanging hooks; every floor of the level is this plank, 7 tiles apart.

objects.name: Hazard-striped plate with beacon lamps
objects.description: Raised floor plate with yellow-black stripes about 8 tiles wide, flanked by small yellow dome lamps on coil-spring posts. Under the start and as the ship landing pad; purpose unclear (landing pad or hatch).

refs.caption: plate with lamps at both ends

objects.name: Chain-link fence
objects.description: Silver diagonal-mesh fence panels about 2 tiles tall between thin steel posts, often with a small grey sign plate; some panels torn. A variant carries a TOXIC!! sign (map cells 101-103, row 49).

objects.name: Lattice pylon
objects.description: Vertical steel truss column with zigzag bracing and riveted flanges, 1 tile wide, floor to ceiling; some stand on a stepped concrete plinth.

objects.name: Girder bridge
objects.description: Horizontal riveted truss beam with X bracing and square gusset plates, 1 tile tall, spanning overhead between pylons and pipe columns.

objects.name: Vertical pipe column
objects.description: Thick grey-bronze vertical pipe with ring joints, 1 tile wide and several tiles tall; on the top floor the same pipes form tall smokestacks.

objects.name: Large L-shaped pipe
objects.description: Big grey pipe running horizontally then bending down to the floor (about 5 x 5 tiles), on the street east of the fuel tank; similar L pipes run along the metro tunnel.

refs.caption: street pipe bend and sign post

objects.name: Fuel tank
objects.description: Horizontal grey cylindrical tank with domed ends and a yellow radiation trefoil on the end, about 4 x 2 tiles, raised on the street. Longer twin tanks sit on the top floor.

objects.name: Concrete building with barred windows
objects.description: Flat-roofed grey stucco block (about 7 x 4 tiles) with three large barred windows, the middle one shot through; low concrete wall beside it.

objects.name: Ruined concrete building
objects.description: Grey concrete facades with stepped roofs, balconies and ragged blast holes in the walls (several variants, 4-8 tiles wide); the dark holes show sky through. Also the tall plain facade with a breach next to the street lift.

objects.name: Colonnade building (block 05)
objects.description: Overhanging grey upper storey on a row of pale square pillars, painted block number 05, open dark bays below; the wire box hangs on its wall.

objects.name: Brick wall and shaft
objects.description: Dark brown brick walls, full floor height, framing lift shafts and buildings, usually with a vertical pipe at the edge.

objects.name: Tall facade towers
objects.description: Multi-storey building facades with vertical pilasters, brick strips and triangular braces, used as level walls (left edge) and as tall towers at the east end (about 9 x 27 tiles).

refs.caption: facade with braces right of lift

objects.name: Graffiti wall
objects.description: Freestanding broken concrete wall (about 7 x 3 tiles) with red, orange and white spray graffiti; a second graffiti wall stands at the east end (cells 135-141, rows 40-44).

objects.name: Gantry building with blue lights
objects.description: Industrial hall front: brown panelled lower storey with dark bays and ceiling lamps, a strip of blue lights above, girder on top and a fenced upper deck.

objects.name: BAR neon sign
objects.description: Big red neon letters B A R on a rusty frame atop a splayed lattice stand (about 4 x 3 tiles) in front of the bar. In footage B and A glow red and R is dark grey-blue; in the map the R cells hold yellow lamp tiles, so R is probably animated (flicker).

refs.caption: map: B A plus lamp tiles

objects.name: Subway train carriage
objects.description: Long white-grey carriages with dark windows, red and grey side stripes and blood splatter, standing on the platform track (about 5 x 3 tiles per car) with dark pillars between cars.

objects.name: Metro platform walls
objects.description: Station walls of blue-grey grid tiles under a band of brick and a gravel-textured ceiling; a large round wall fan unit (about 2 x 2 tiles) sits by the lift.

objects.name: Metro tunnel wall
objects.description: Concrete wall with a steel frame, 4 tiles wide and as tall as the metro hall, at map cols 56-59, filling the gap between the two train doors. The train runs behind it; it blocks the tunnel until the train door is open, then the hero passes through the train.
objects.note: Not an original object: the original blocks the dark tunnel with an invisible task wall (metroTunnel); this asset gives that gate a look.

objects.name: Train carriage body
objects.description: The train door carriage carried on to the left behind the tunnel wall, about 13 tiles long: an open door just left of the wall (the hero leaves the train there), two windows, a closed door near the far end, stripe, blood, end cap.
objects.note: Not an original object: joins the train door carriage so the train reads as one body through the tunnel wall.

objects.name: Metro tunnel walls
objects.description: Rough grey concrete wall panels split by riveted steel pillars, dark ceiling with a long horizontal pipe; two corridors stack per screen.

objects.name: Tunnel strip light
objects.description: White fluorescent bar about 1.5 tiles wide under the tunnel ceiling, casting a pale cone on the wall.
states: dark before switchboard (inferred from NENÍ TAM SVĚTLO)

objects.name: Tunnel floor rail
objects.description: Thin metal walkway with a yellow-black hazard stripe and short posts every few tiles; used on metro platform and tunnel floors.

objects.name: Boulder rubble pile
objects.description: Heap of large grey angular boulders blocking part of a tunnel (about 4 x 4 tiles); smaller scrap and broken posts lie on streets.

objects.name: Collapsed girder wreckage
objects.description: Tangle of fallen diagonal beams and debris (about 5 x 4 tiles) east of the controller spot.

objects.name: Diagonal staircase with railings
objects.description: Steep diagonal stair stringers with orange handrails (about 5 x 4 tiles) beside the crane on the top floor; not used in footage, maybe decor.

objects.name: Wall-base vent grille
objects.description: Small grey slotted grilles (about 1 x 0.3 tiles) at the foot of concrete walls.

objects.name: Street sign post
objects.description: Thin grey pole with a small box or plate on top, about 2 tiles tall, standing on the street.

objects.name: Ladder
objects.description: Steel ladder with two rails and chrome rungs, climbed by the hero; height follows the ladder cells, rung spacing matches the game climb steps.
